limits: This package retains two official deck components and four separately classified tower objects.
High suspension cables are absent from the retained six source objects; any additional cable visual is a separate labelled approximation.
Source bridge geometry and tower-footprint records have different revision/elevation values; immutable source fields are not forced to agree.
No public walking permission, road traffic simulation or navigational bathymetry is provided.
